events.outcome: Current TIM support states that a TIM Card is valid for 12 months from activation, the last recharge or another qualifying customer-requested commercial event. If none occurs, month 13 is receive-calls-and-SMS only, then the SIM/number is deactivated. TIM currently allows free number reactivation within a maximum 11 months after expiry.

TIM still sells Ricarica 5+ for EUR5. It includes EUR4 prepaid credit plus a temporary bundle. Because TIM explicitly resets card validity from the last recharge, EUR5 remains the lowest currently documented paid recharge action found in the reviewed first-party material for resetting the lifecycle clock. This is an annual retention action, not a claim that EUR5 of ordinary credit is added.

Current TIM mobile pages list a EUR10 one-time SIM cost for new prepaid customers. Online, EUR5 is prepaid credit and EUR5 is SIM activation; in TIM stores, EUR0.01 is residual credit and EUR9.99 is SIM activation. Offer-specific monthly charges are separate from this normalized SIM acquisition baseline.

TIM currently supports physical SIM and eSIM for new prepaid mobile customers, with online identification via SPID or video selfie. The online flow requires an Italian Codice Fiscale and a valid identity document; TIM explicitly lists passport among accepted identity documents for the switch-to-TIM flow. Card payment for that online flow is documented for cards issued in Italy, while courier identification can use cash. These requirements do not establish a frictionless offshore/non-resident first-activation path.

TIM currently markets use of the customer's TIM mobile number abroad and offers international roaming products, including China as a travel destination. The reviewed consumer pages do not provide exact regular-prepaid original-number incoming-SMS or app/OTP delivery guarantees for mainland China, so roaming existence must not be promoted as China OTP reliability.

guideSteps: Confirm you can satisfy TIM onboarding requirements, including Codice Fiscale and the chosen identification/payment flow; do not assume passport alone makes offshore activation frictionless.

Use a current EUR5 Ricarica 5+ recharge before the 12-month full-service deadline to reset the TIM Card lifecycle clock.
If the SIM expires, request free number reactivation within TIM's documented maximum 11-month recovery window.
Before relying on the number in mainland China, verify current partner-network and incoming-SMS behavior; no exact China/app OTP reliability percentage is established.
